title: Baccha Shoshur
desc: Spandan leads a blissful married life with his wife, Jonaki. However, things take a hilarious turn after their son, Gutlu, is born.

title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

desc: A happy family goes through various trials and tribulations and falls apart when greed takes precedence over relationships.

desc: Mittir Mess's landlord dies. The new owners want to sell the property. The residents of the boarding house struggle to deal with its consequences.

title: Ostad
desc: Sanjay and Mili, two college goers, fall in love with each other. Their fathers are business rivals and this creates various problems in their lives.

desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Tobu Bhalobashi
desc: Raj falls in love with the pregnant wife of a man he accidentally kills on a rainy day.

desc: Competitive peers Balu and Mahalakshmi have ego clashes while in college. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realise that they are in love.

title: Projapati
desc: A 65-year-old retired widower, living alone with his son Joy, hopes he will marry to ease his loneliness. However, Joy, a busy wedding planner, has no plans to settle down anytime soon.
